product.note: NEW PACK — the first built for the print-on-demand audience the last three videos created. tshirt-pod, sublimation and cricut-svg all had to point at sticker-illustration-kit and by the Cricut video the fit had worn through. product.description: Editable Canva seamless pattern tile — 1200 x 1200 px (an 8 inch repeat at 150 DPI) with the offset structure already built, plus a 2400 x 2400 proof sheet for the 2x2 seam test, and five reference PDFs: the offset arithmetic worked including the corner case, the marketplace spec with the inches x 150 table, the seam-test method, the scale and colourway guide, and a read-me (Genius Junkie)
